title: Hypoxia geography and persistence
query:
Characterize the spatial distribution, onset, persistence, and recovery of bottom-water hypoxia off the Pearl River Estuary in 2011. Assess whether the western and eastern shelf regions exhibit different behavior.

Independently identify relevant literature and appropriate methods. Deliver an evidence-based report, supporting figures, and one executable analysis notebook. Distinguish demonstrated results from mechanisms that the supplied data cannot establish.
